editions.label: from the workshop
editions.intro: Recent updates to our apps focus on better task management, more reliable racing data, and improved model downloads.

items.body: Project Manager now lets you remove due dates from tasks so they no longer appear overdue. You can also see exactly when a task was created and how long it has been open.
E-Grid now provides race, qualifying, and sprint results from a second source during live sessions, ensuring data is available even when the primary timing provider is locked.
MyLLM now handles mobile data downloads correctly. You can choose to download immediately or wait for Wi-Fi, and you can opt to always download on mobile data to skip the check.

principles.free: Every Opticell app is free to download. You can install our software and test it on your own device without providing any card details or committing to a purchase. This allows you to judge the utility of the tool before deciding to unlock its full features.
principles.upgrades: You can choose between an ultra-affordable subscription or a one-time lifetime unlock. Both options are entirely opt-in. Subscriptions can be managed or cancelled at any time through your Apple or Google account settings.
principles.pricing: We believe you should know the cost before you commit. Every price is clearly visible on the App Store and Google Play product pages before installation. We also show all costs within the app itself, with no hidden fees or fine print.
principles.privacy: Privacy is our default setting. We do not use analytics to track your usage, nor do we sell information to advertisers or data brokers. Your data stays on your device where it belongs.
principles.ads: Our apps contain no banners, interstitials, or sponsored content. Advertisements compete for your attention and create an incentive for apps to harvest user data. We avoid this model entirely to keep our software focused and clean.
principles.partnership: Where our apps use AI, the technology is designed to extend human capability rather than replace human judgement. The software acts as a tool to assist your workflow, ensuring that you always remain in control of the final outcome.
principles.audience: Our catalogue provides tools for both personal use and professional environments on the same terms. Whether you are using DrawPad for creative work or My Business Portal for organisation, you receive the same honest service.

editions.label: from the workshop
editions.intro: Our latest updates focus on improving document handling in Project Manager, streamlining model downloads in MyLLM, and enhancing race highlights in E-Grid.

items.body: Project Manager now lets you scan documents directly into a note as both an image and searchable text. You can also insert tables into the Notepad and save attachments anywhere.
MyLLM now handles mobile data downloads more reliably. You can choose to download immediately or wait for Wi-Fi, and you can opt to always allow downloads on mobile data.
E-Grid now features official highlight reels directly on channel pages. These clips show the race highlights and closing laps without needing to switch apps or search manually.

editions.label: from the workshop
editions.intro: Recent updates focus on improving interface stability and refining how our apps interact with your device hardware.

items.body: Project Manager now keeps unread conversations in place while you read them. You can also reply directly from the inbox and use a new long-press menu to manage tasks and replies.
LinkFindr now features functional iCloud sync with a manual toggle. The settings menu provides an honest status of your connection, and links saved via the Share Sheet appear reliably.
MyLLM now displays on-device replies as they are being written. This prevents the app from appearing frozen during long generations and ensures the interface remains responsive and scrollable.
